rca of the issue:
Same as iteration_7. Tailwind's `lg:px-20` is a shorthand setting BOTH padding-left and padding-right to 5rem at >=1024px, which cascades on top of `sm:pr-56` and resets the footer's right padding to 80px at desktop. The Emergent badge is fixed at right:16px with width ~178px (so it occupies 1726-1904 in a 1920 viewport), but the CTA button's right edge sits at x≈1840 because the footer only provides 80px right padding. The button is therefore drawn under the badge, and document.elementFromPoint at the button's geometric center returns the badge's

element rather than the button — meaning Playwright's normal click (and a real desktop user's click) hits the badge link instead of advancing the wizard. Mitigation: replace `lg:px-20` with split-axis classes `lg:pl-20 lg:pr-60` so the lg breakpoint cannot clobber the right padding. Confirmed working pattern at sm (which uses `pr-56` without an `lg:` overrider) — paddingRight=224px on tablet and the button is reachable.
